title: Into the Mirror
overview: Woo Yeong-min retired from the police force after trying to save his partner and causing his death. After a series of mysterious deaths in the shopping mall in which his uncle has allowed him to work as a security guard prior to its reopening, he must face both his own fear of mirrors and the mystery surrounding the fire that closed down the mall.

◉　Plot

　　Woo Yeong-min retired from the police force after trying to save his partner and causing his death. After
　　a series of mysterious deaths in the shopping mall in which his uncle has allowed him to work as a
　　security guard prior to its reopening, he must face both his own fear of mirrors and the mystery
　　surrounding the fire that closed down the mall.
